description: Subagent evidence card schema for default-parallel buy-side research skills. Each subagent outputs one card per ticker. Main agent collects, compares, and synthesizes.

financial_highlights.net_cash: float (m) or null — cash minus total debt

business_profile.model: string — e.g. order-driven equipment, process-industry, saas
business_profile.one_liner: string — ≤120 chars, what the company does and why it matters

competitive_position.barriers: string — qualification cycle, switching cost, IP, scale

long_short_sentiment.key_debate: string — the single most important fork in the thesis

key_claims_needing_verification: string — specific claim that couldn't be sourced, needs follow-up

evidence_triplets.claim: string — one verifiable factual claim from this card
evidence_triplets.evidence: string — the supporting data or observation

usage.subagent_output: one JSON object per ticker, conforming to this schema
usage.main_agent_embed: select 1-3 key evidence_triplets per card into artifact as claim:/evidence:/source: lines in ## Evidence Cards section
usage.hook_check: subagent_protocol.py counts claim:/evidence:/source: lines. Need >=3 matches (one triplet) for DEFAULT_PARALLEL skills.
